# Kungfu Systems community-health default candidate

This directory is a reviewable candidate for the future public
`kungfu-systems/.github` repository. Its nested location is intentionally inert:
GitHub does not treat these files as organization defaults from this repository.

Publication requires a human-reviewed repository-creation plan, protected
pull-request flow, live readback, and rollback decision. Copy only these public
files to the organization default repository. Repository-specific Issue Forms,
technical routing, ownership, and `area/*` or `platform/*` labels remain local.
